method: One independent reviewer; no delegation. All 32 source PNGs and all 104 crops opened visually. Native-pixel crop sheets were supplemented by 26 native-resolution four-edge source/context sheets (48 pixels inside and 12 outside each edge; side strips rotated without resampling). Each complete crop was compared with its source for number, variants, exercise ID, attribution, notation, figures, staff ends, lowest stems and realization title. Old partial review logs were not used as authority. Lossless source pixels, not generated imagery, were used for temporary recrop tests.

Continuations 3.28 e/f on 186 and 3.67 e/f on 201, both realization slots, and both exercise series were checked explicitly.
mechanical_checks.captions: 104 manifest captions identify the corresponding example/exercise/realization and printed page. Text drafts contain visual slots rather than final image alt-text/caption blocks; this review does not certify an unbuilt integrated chapter.

conventions.page: Printed source page; PDF page is independently checked as described above.
conventions.proposed_rect: Exclusive right/bottom source-pixel coordinates [left,top,right,bottom]. Non-null only for a complete, visually source-tested safe crop. Proposals have NOT been applied; current image remains RECROP_REQUIRED.
conventions.source_limited: True means a safe rectangular correction preserving required content was not found because foreign source ink or adjacent required content occupies the necessary bounds. Do not retouch, paint, or clip notation to resolve it.
conventions.PASS: All four edges inspected at native resolution; required printed content complete, feasible genuine source whitespace retained, no surrounding prose, unrelated example, printed page number, stamp, barcode, handwriting or foreign partial mark visible. Isolated scan grain is not treated as a handwritten character.
conventions.continuation_numbers: Continuation images on 186 and 201 do not repeat the example number in the source; their e/f labels and the previous-page numbered part establish identity. No missing number was invented.
